thesis: This episode argues that traditional telecom giants like Verizon and AT&T are facing disruption from community-owned networks like Helium, which offer cheaper services by avoiding massive infrastructure spending. It also suggests that Google's AI chatbots are breaking economic promises to small businesses by not delivering on traffic commitments despite training data.
